achievementCompleted.title: You Earned a Reward!
achievementCompleted.body: Nice work! You just completed an achievement. Tap to claim your coins before they expire.

leaderboardRankMilestone.title: Leaderboard Milestone!
leaderboardRankMilestone.body: You just climbed to #{rank} on this week's leaderboard. Keep earning XP to defend your spot!

leaderboardPodiumWithinReach.title: A podium spot is within reach
leaderboardPodiumWithinReach.body: You're #{rank}, just {pointsBehind} XP behind #3. The leaderboard resets in {hoursLeft} hours — one more push could do it!

leaderboardRankLost.title: Knocked out of the top 3
leaderboardRankLost.body: {userName} just passed you — you're #{rank} on this week's leaderboard. Earn a little XP today to take your spot back!
leaderboardRankLost.bodyAnonymous: Someone just passed you — you're #{rank} on this week's leaderboard. Earn a little XP today to take your spot back!

connectionRequestAccepted.title: You're Connected!
connectionRequestAccepted.body: {userName} accepted your request — say hello and start a conversation!

createAMomentReminder.title: Share What You're Up To
createAMomentReminder.body: Drop a moment at your favorite spot — a quick review, a photo, or something fun. Your friends nearby will discover it later!

completeDraftReminder.title: Your Draft Is Waiting
completeDraftReminder.body: You started a post but never shared it — finish it up and let your community see what you've been up to!

createYourProfileReminder.title: Finish Setting Up Your Profile
createYourProfileReminder.body: You're almost there! Pick a username and add a photo so people in your area can find you.

discoveredUniqueMoment.title: You Found Something Special!
discoveredUniqueMoment.body: There's a rare moment nearby — open the map to check it out.

discoveredUniqueSpace.title: Hidden Gem Alert!
discoveredUniqueSpace.body: You're near a unique space — tap to explore what makes it special.

latestPostLikesStats.title: Your Post Is Getting Love
latestPostLikesStats.body: Your latest post just hit {likeCount} likes! Keep sharing to grow your local following.

latestPostViewcountStats.title: People Are Watching
latestPostViewcountStats.body: Your latest post has reached {viewCount} views — your community is paying attention.

newDirectMessage.title: New Message
newDirectMessage.body: You have unread messages from {userName} — tap to reply

newGroupMessage.title: New Group Message
newGroupMessage.body: You have unread messages in {groupName} — jump in and join the conversation

newGroupInvite.title: You're Invited!
newGroupInvite.body: {fromUserName} invited you to join {groupName} — tap to check it out

newSuperLikeReceived.title: You Got a Super Like!
newSuperLikeReceived.body: {userName} super-liked your post — they really love it!

newThoughtReplyReceived.title: New Reply to Your Post
newThoughtReplyReceived.body: {userName} replied to your post — see what they said

newThoughtRepostReceived.title: Your Post Was Reposted
newThoughtRepostReceived.body: {userName} reposted your post — it's reaching a new audience

newAreasActivated.title: New Spots Unlocked!
newAreasActivated.body: You just unlocked {totalAreasActivated} new area(s) — explore what's been shared nearby

nudgeSpaceEngagement.title: Earn Rewards Right Now
nudgeSpaceEngagement.body: You're near a spot with rewards — check in to claim cash back and discounts!

unclaimedAchievementsReminder.title: Rewards Waiting for You
unclaimedAchievementsReminder.body: You have {achievementsCount} unclaimed reward(s) waiting — tap to collect them.

unreadNotificationsReminder.title: You've Got Updates
unreadNotificationsReminder.body: You have {notificationsCount} new notification(s) — tap to catch up

inviteFriendsReminder.title: Bring Your Crew Along
inviteFriendsReminder.body: Share your invite link and you'll both earn rewards when your friends join!

streakAtRisk.title: Keep Your Streak Going
streakAtRisk.body: Your {streakCount}-day {habitName} streak is ready for today. One check-in before the day ends extends it.
streakAtRisk.bodyWithFreeze: Your {streakCount}-day {habitName} streak is ready for today. A streak freeze has your back if you miss ({freezesRemaining} left) — and checking in keeps it in your pocket.
streakAtRisk.bodyMultiple: {habitCount} streaks are ready for today — {habitNames}. Check in before the day ends to extend them.
streakAtRisk.bodyWeekly: {weekDone} of {weekTarget} on {habitName} this week, and {daysLeft} day(s) left. Keep your {streakCount} in a row going.
streakAtRisk.bodyOfferPause: Your {streakCount}-day {habitName} streak is ready for today, and you're out of streak freezes. Check in before the day ends to extend it — or pause it if you need a break.

streakFreezeUsed.title: Your Streak Survived
streakFreezeUsed.body: You missed a day on {habitName}, so a streak freeze covered it — your {streakCount}-day streak is intact. {freezesRemaining} freeze(s) left.

pledgeMissed.title: Your {habitName} pledge
pledgeMissed.body: You missed your {habitName} target last week. Your pledge: ${pledgeAmount} to {charityName}. Open the app when you're ready to honor it.

streakBroken.title: Streak Reset
streakBroken.body: Your {streakCount}-day {habitName} streak ended — start a new one today.

streakMilestone.title: Milestone Hit!
streakMilestone.body: {streakCount} days strong on {habitName} — keep the momentum going.

newPersonalRecord.title: New Personal Record
newPersonalRecord.body: You just beat your old {habitName} record of {previousRecordDays} days. Now at {streakCount}!

partnerCheckedIn.title: {partnerName} Just Checked In
partnerCheckedIn.body: {partnerName} hit Day {streakCount} on {habitName} — check in and keep pace together.

pactMessage.title: {habitName} pact
pactMessage.bodyNoPreview: {userName} sent a message to your pact.

partnerCelebrated.title: {partnerName} Sent a Celebration
partnerCelebrated.body: {partnerName} just cheered you on — open the app to see what they said.

pactInvitation.title: You've Been Invited to a Pact
pactInvitation.body: {userName} invited you to do {habitName} together — accountability starts here.

pactNudge.title: A Friendly Nudge
pactNudge.body: {partnerName} is still waiting on you to join the {habitName} pact — accountability starts here.

pactAccepted.title: Pact Accepted!
pactAccepted.body: {partnerName} is in. You're both committed to {habitName} — first check-in starts the streak.

pactDeclined.title: Pact Declined
pactDeclined.body: {partnerName} can't commit to this one. Invite someone else to keep the goal alive.

pactMemberLeft.title: A Member Left Your Pact
pactMemberLeft.body: {partnerName} left your group pact. Everyone else is still in — your streak keeps going.

pactCompleted.title: Pact Complete!
pactCompleted.body: You and {partnerName} finished your {habitName} pact — that's a win for both of you.

pactExpiring.title: {habitName}: {daysRemaining} day(s) left
pactExpiring.body: Renew now for another {durationDays} days in one tap.
pactExpiring.bodyWithStreak: You're on a {streakCount}-day streak. Renew for another {durationDays} days and keep it going.

pactEnded.title: Your {habitName} Pact Wrapped Up
pactEnded.body: {durationDays} days in. Most habits take months, not weeks — start a new cycle and your streak carries over.
pactEnded.bodyWithStreak: Your {streakCount}-day streak comes with you. Start another {durationDays} days in one tap.

pactJoinRequested.title: New request to join your pact
pactJoinRequested.body: {userName} asked to join your {habitName} pact. Open the pact to say yes or no.

pactJoinApproved.title: You're in!
pactJoinApproved.body: {userName} let you into their {habitName} pact. Check in today to get started.

openPactSuggestion.title: Still waiting on a partner?
openPactSuggestion.body: Nobody has answered your {habitName} invite yet. Others are doing it in open pacts — ask to join one.

openPactAvailable.title: A new {habitName} pact is open
openPactAvailable.body: Someone just opened a {habitName} pact and has room. Ask to join — open-pact check-ins earn bonus XP.

habitsFirstHabitNudge.title: Day 1 takes ten seconds
habitsFirstHabitNudge.body: Pick one habit and check in once. That is your streak started.

pactInviteUnclaimed.title: {partnerName} hasn't joined yet
pactInviteUnclaimed.body: Your {habitName} invite is still waiting. Send it again — a nudge from you lands better than one from us.

habitsFounderOffer.title: {checkinCount} check-ins. You're building something.
habitsFounderOffer.body: Unlock unlimited habits for life with one payment. No subscription.

challengeJoined.title: {userName} joined your challenge
challengeJoined.body: Your {habitName} challenge just got bigger. Check in today to stay ahead.

habitsReferralRewardEarned.title: You unlocked Friends with Habits for life
habitsReferralRewardEarned.body: Your friends kept showing up, so everything is unlocked. No payment, no subscription. Thank you for bringing them.

dailyHabitReminder.title: Time to Check In
dailyHabitReminder.body: Log {habitName} today — one check-in gets your streak going.
dailyHabitReminder.bodyMultiple: {habitCount} habits are waiting today — {habitNames}. One check-in gets you started.
dailyHabitReminder.bodyWeekly: {weekDone} of {weekTarget} on {habitName} this week — {daysLeft} day(s) left to finish it.

firstCheckin.title: Day 1 of {habitName}
firstCheckin.body: One tap and your streak starts today.
firstCheckin.bodyWithPartner: {partnerName} is in. One tap and your streak starts today.

dayTwo.title: Day 2 of {habitName}
dayTwo.body: Yesterday you started. Today makes it a streak.
dayTwo.bodyWithPartner: {partnerName} is in it with you. Today makes it a streak.

comeback.title: {habitName} is still here for you
comeback.body: One check-in starts it again, and your first one back pays a comeback bonus.
comeback.bodyWithPartner: {partnerName} is still in. One check-in starts it again, with a comeback bonus.

comebackNoBonus.title: {habitName} is still here for you
comebackNoBonus.body: One check-in starts it again. No catching up needed.
comebackNoBonus.bodyWithPartner: {partnerName} is still in. One check-in starts it again.

freshStart.title: Still want to start {habitName}?
freshStart.body: Day 1 is one tap. Nothing to catch up on.
freshStart.bodyWithPartner: {partnerName} is ready when you are. Day 1 is one tap.

morningMotivation.title: Good Morning
morningMotivation.body: Today is a fresh chance to build the habit you committed to. Let's go.

eveningCheckIn.title: Your Chance to Extend Your Streak
eveningCheckIn.body: Extend your {streakCount}-day {habitName} streak before the night ends. One check-in does it.
eveningCheckIn.bodyWithFreeze: Extend your {streakCount}-day {habitName} streak before the night ends. A streak freeze has your back ({freezesRemaining} left) — and checking in keeps it in your pocket.
eveningCheckIn.bodyMultiple: There's still time tonight to extend {habitCount} streaks — {habitNames}.
eveningCheckIn.bodyWeekly: {weekDone} of {weekTarget} on {habitName}, with {daysLeft} day(s) left. A check-in tonight keeps your week on track.
eveningCheckIn.bodyOfferPause: Extend your {streakCount}-day {habitName} streak before the night ends — or, with no freezes left, pause it to keep it safe while you take a break.

body.perfectWeek: All seven days upheld and {checkinCount} check-ins. Tap to see the week you just had.
body.firstWeek: {checkinCount} check-ins across {perfectDays} days — your first week is on the board. Tap to see it.
body.improved: {checkinCount} check-ins last week, up on the week before. Tap for the full picture.
body.steady: {checkinCount} check-ins last week, same as the week before. Steady is how habits stick — tap to see it.
body.declined: {checkinCount} check-ins last week. Tap to see where the week went, then start this one fresh.

habitEstablished.title: {habitName} Is Sticking
habitEstablished.body: {consistencyPercent}% consistent over {dayCount} days. We'll ease off the daily reminders — you've got this one.

habitAutomaticity.title: This One's Automatic
habitAutomaticity.body: {dayCount} days of {habitName}. Research puts habits around here when they stop taking willpower. Daily reminders off — we'll just check in now and then.

habitMaintenanceCheckIn.title: {dayCount}-Day Check-In
habitMaintenanceCheckIn.body: Still going with {habitName}? You're {consistencyPercent}% consistent since we backed off. Tap to confirm you're on track.

habitComeback.title: Want to Restart {habitName}?
habitComeback.body: You held this {bestStreakCount} days once — that doesn't go away. Ready to start a fresh streak?

week.title: Ready to Pick Up {habitName}?
week.body: It's been a week since you paused. Resume whenever you're ready — one check-in starts it back up.
week.bodyWithStreak: It's been a week since you paused. Your {streakCount}-day streak is right where you left it — one check-in picks it back up.

twoWeeks.title: Still on a Break From {habitName}?
twoWeeks.body: Two weeks paused. A small check-in today is all a restart takes.
twoWeeks.bodyWithStreak: Two weeks paused, and your {streakCount}-day streak is still safe. A small check-in today gets it moving again.

final.title: Last Reminder About {habitName}
final.body: A month paused. This is the last time we'll ask — resume it when you're ready, or archive it if it's run its course.
final.bodyWithStreak: A month paused. Your {streakCount}-day streak stays saved, and this is the last time we'll ask — resume it when you're ready, or archive it if it's run its course.
